items.summary: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
items.recommend_reason_zh: Nutlope/hallmark 为 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Codex 提供反 AI 套路化设计的技能，想避免设计产出千篇一律时值得打开看看。
items.recommend_reason_en: Nutlope/hallmark is an anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, worth opening to see how it approaches reducing generic AI-generated design.

items.summary: Documents of the future, made by AI, read by your team
items.recommend_reason_zh: Spacesheep用AI生成供团队阅读的文档，想看看AI如何产出团队可读的文档，值得打开体验。
items.recommend_reason_en: Spacesheep turns AI-made documents of the future into something your team can read, making it worth opening to explore a speculative take on tomorrow’s documents.

items.summary: A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration.
items.recommend_reason_zh: nightly-labs/openbot 提供本地优先的桌面工作区，可让 Codex、Claude、Grok 各自拥有工作区、任务队列、文件共享、浏览器控制和代理协作，适合体验持久 AI 团队。
items.recommend_reason_en: nightly-labs/openbot is a local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates, letting Codex, Claude, and Grok use dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration, making it worth opening to explore multi-agent workflows.

items.summary: On-device AI, connected tools, and creative workflows
items.recommend_reason_zh: NINX把端侧AI、互联工具和创意工作流放在一起，适合想体验本地AI如何串起创作工具的人打开看看。
items.recommend_reason_en: NINX combines on-device AI, connected tools, and creative workflows, making it worth opening to explore how these elements come together in one project.
